summary: Iteration 6 verifies the three iter5 fixes and completes the previously-skipped per-request override live-call cases. All 3 fixes GREEN. (1) GET /api/users normalisation: list_users() now emits call_mode (default 'phone') and agent_extension (default '') for every row; test_users_list_returns_new_fields PASSES (previously the only red test). Mongo confirms 0/18 user docs lack call_mode after the startup update_many migration. (2) Non-numeric extension rejection: PATCH /api/calls/preferences {call_mode:'desktop', agent_extension:'1024a'} then POST /api/calls/click-to-call returns 400 with 'Your Smartflo extension must be digits only (e.g. 1024)' and writes NO call_attempts row — Tata is not called. Clean '1024' still dials. (3) Transport-error audit branch: code inspection of /app/backend/server.py lines 703-715 confirms the httpx exception insert now includes call_mode alongside agent_number/destination_number, matching the success branch at 728-736. Per-request override live calls (2/2 budget used, both to 9810012301): (a) stored=desktop+ext=1024, body call_mode='phone' -> audit row call_mode='phone', agent_number='919812345678'; (b) stored=phone, body call_mode='desktop' -> audit row call_mode='desktop', agent_number='1024'. Both PASS. Regression: test_call_modes.py 17 pass + 2 intentional skips (previous unbudgeted live tests); backend_test.py + test_export_tz.py 71/71 pass; test_smartflo.py non-live 17/17 pass (live-call tests deselected via -k filter: live_call_result / test_click_to_call_success_response / test_click_to_call_normalises_number_and_persists / test_click_to_call_writes_lead_activity); test_documents.py 12/13 pass with ONE test-only assertion mismatch (RFC 5987 filename* vs plain filename=, endpoint works — pre-existing brittleness, unrelated to this iteration). Frontend smoke (owner butbrucewill@gmail.com, 1920x1080 + 390x844): call-settings-card renders on /dialer, call-mode-desktop / call-mode-phone switch, call-settings-extension persists =1024 after full reload, softphone-extension-link href=https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/smartflo-softphone/dbhcchccbhpnohpmcallfdfcfnogdfpo rel='noopener noreferrer' target=_blank, /users shows 21 user-call-mode-* + 21 user-agent-extension-* testids, no horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390).
